cohort: The study included 60 women with hypertension disorder and 60 normal pregnant women from the AL-Imam AL-Sadiq hospital, aged fifteen and older.
finding: Hypertensive groups showed an increase in preterm delivery, low Apgar score, low birth weight, and low placental weight, with electron microscope findings (SEM) revealing vasculopathy, diffuse placental thrombosis, infarction, calcification, vasculosyncytial membrane thickness, and dysfunction of syncytiotrophoblast cells related to the severity of hypertensive disorders.
